description: Mark a problem category solved after its fix is deployed, or open it again. Solved is a claim, not a removal: the next problem sorted into the category opens it again, which is how the team learns whether the fix held. When the user says the fix is in, mark it solved, then suggest running the tests that found it.

category.description: The category's id or title, as list_problem_categories shows them.
category.title: Category

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

solved.description: True marks it solved, false open again.
solved.title: Solved

name: set_category_solved
